Scandora vs. Fileee: an honest comparison

Published: July 14, 2026

In short: Fileee is a document app by fileee GmbH in Hamburg. The clearest verifiable difference is the approach: Scandora keeps documents on your device by default and syncs them directly into your own tools (Trello, Drive, accounting) instead of storing them in a vendor archive. On top of that come managed AI with no key setup and real network scanners over eSCL/AirScan. DATEV/lexoffice/sevDesk export is in preparation for the Business / DATEV plan and is not available in this version yet. This page compares the two neutrally and says honestly when Fileee is the better choice. For Fileee's current feature set, check fileee's own site.

The architecture difference: your storage, not a cloud archive

The most important difference is not a single feature — it's the underlying architecture. Many document apps follow a hosted-archive model: your receipts live in the vendor's cloud, and you reach them through the vendor's app.

Scandora deliberately takes the opposite approach. Your original scans stay on your device and go only to the storage you choose; they sync directly into your own tools and storage — a Trello card, your own cloud drive, or your accounting, for example. On our EU servers we store only a low-resolution preview and the extracted text so your history syncs across your devices — never your original files. You remain the owner and custodian of your records; Scandora is the tool that captures and sorts them, not the place they live.

What that means in practice:

  • No vendor lock-in of your documents. Your receipts sit where they belong — in your services, not in an archive tied to a subscription.
  • Fewer data paths. What doesn't leave the device doesn't need to be stored, encrypted and later deleted on someone else's servers.
  • You keep the choice of storage. Trello for workflows, a cloud folder for bookkeeping, a DATEV export for your tax advisor (coming soon) — Scandora delivers receipts to where you already work.

Whether and how Fileee stores documents is a property of that provider — the binding answer is in its privacy policy or on its website.

Managed AI instead of a chosen-for-you cloud AI

Scandora uses AI for data extraction — through managed AI. Your device calls the model provider directly, using a short-lived credential Scandora's server issues, billed as prepaid credits. You don't need to set up your own key or manage a provider account.

With services that run AI through their own backend using a provider you can't choose, that path is less transparent. For how any given provider processes your documents with AI, see its privacy policy. More on Scandora's model is in the help article Managed AI & credits.

Real network scanners over eSCL/AirScan

Scandora pulls in receipts through the camera and directly from a real network scanner over eSCL/AirScan — the standard many Brother, Epson and other devices already support. For anyone processing stacks daily, that's the difference between "photograph one sheet" and "run the feeder."

Setup is covered in the guide Set up a network scanner via eSCL. Whether Fileee supports network scanners is a question for the provider.

DATEV & GoBD for small businesses

For freelancers and small businesses, what matters most is that receipts arrive cleanly at the tax advisor and in the books. Scandora is built for that:

  • DATEV export. A DATEV-format export (EXTF booking batch) plus lexoffice and sevDesk voucher export are in preparation for the Business / DATEV plan and are not available in this version yet. Details in the guide DATEV export from your smartphone.
  • GoBD building blocks. A content hash (SHA-256), an immutable audit log, and a generatable Verfahrensdokumentation (coming soon) — the technical basis for substitutive scanning. What that covers (and what it doesn't) is explained in Scanning for GoBD. Scandora carries no "GoBD certificate" — there is none for individual apps.

This page is not legal or tax advice; the GoBD compliance of your books is ensured by your tax advisor. Verify Fileee's current export and record-keeping features on its own site.

When Fileee is the better choice

Honesty is part of the brand: Fileee isn't a bad choice, it's a different one. If you specifically want a hosted document archive — a service that stores, manages and serves your documents for you through its own app — then such a hosted service may suit you better than Scandora's "stays with you" approach. If you'd rather not maintain your own cloud folder and instead want a fully hosted solution, an archive model serves you well. Check the provider's current offering on its own site and decide by your workflow.

FAQ

What is the fundamental difference between Scandora and Fileee?

Fileee is a document app by fileee GmbH in Hamburg. The clearest verifiable difference is the approach: Scandora keeps documents on your device by default and syncs directly into your own tools (Trello, Drive, accounting) instead of storing them in a vendor archive. Check fileee's own site for their current feature set.

Can I bring my own AI key?

With Scandora you don't need your own key — managed AI runs extraction directly from your device to Google Gemini. For Fileee, verify the current AI options on the provider's site.

When is Fileee the better choice?

If you specifically want a hosted document archive where the provider stores and organises your records for you, a hosted service may suit you better. Scandora deliberately takes the opposite approach: your documents stay in your own storage.

Which one exports to DATEV?

Scandora's DATEV-format export (EXTF booking batch) and its lexoffice and sevDesk voucher export are coming soon on the Business / DATEV plan and are not available in this version yet. Verify Fileee's current export options on their own site.
